paper_title: Search for Axion-Like Particles produced in $e^+e^-$ collisions at Belle II
notes: Belle II search for e+e- -> gamma a, a -> gamma gamma. Sets 95% CL upper limits on g_agamma at the level of ~10^-3 GeV^-1 over the mass range 0.2 < m_a < 9.7 GeV/c^2. This is a collider production search (not a DM haloscope), so no DM density applies. Numerical limit values vs mass are provided in supplemental text file, not reproduced in the paper body; data points are approximate from the quoted ~10^-3 GeV^-1 level and should be treated as rough representative values only. Mass values converted from GeV to eV.
